title: CompMotifs
description: I co-lead CompMotifs, a community that brings researchers together at hackathons to work on computational problems in the natural sciences.

title: Proteina-Complexa
description: A generative model for protein complexes. We studied how scaling the training data and giving the model more time to search affect its ability to design protein binders.
alt: Protein dimer illustration from the Proteina-Complexa project

title: ProteinWorkshop
description: A benchmark suite for comparing what machine learning models learn from protein structures, with shared datasets and evaluation tasks.

title: AtomWorks
description: A Python toolkit for reading biomolecular structures and preparing them for machine learning. It gives researchers a common way to represent proteins, nucleic acids, and small molecules.

title: RFD4-Proteina
description: A collaboration between the Institute for Protein Design and NVIDIA exploring how latent reasoning can improve biomolecular design.
alt: Molecular rendering of a ligase from RFD4-Proteina

title: BioHacks 2023
description: BioHack London and the online BioxML Hackathon brought machine learning researchers and biologists together in 2023. Follow-up events took place in New York City and elsewhere.
